tagline: Creating a more enjoyable, connected, and safe driving experience.
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the driver of Visteon's future growth, reflecting customer confidence in its next-generation cockpit technologies and its ability to support increased software content and advanced in-cabin features.

kpis.name: New Business Awards
kpis.explanation: Total value of new contracts signed by the company for its products and services.
kpis.description: Represents future revenue secured through new customer contracts, a key indicator of future growth.
kpis.signal: Strong commercial momentum for next-generation cockpit technologies.

kpis.name: Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from the sale of the company's products and services.
kpis.description: Visteon's consolidated sales, impacted by raw material price recovery and market weakness.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in sales despite outperformance relative to customer production.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net profit of the company after deduction of all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income attributable to Visteon, affected by higher tax provision but offset by lower restructuring costs.
kpis.signal: Net profitability maintained despite sales decline, driven by strong operational performance.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Measure of operating performance before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, adjusted for non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Key indicator of operating performance, demonstrating disciplined cost management and commercial execution.
kpis.signal: Adjusted EBITDA margin expansion for the fifth consecutive year.

kpis.name: Capital Allocation to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Amount of capital returned to shareholders through dividends and share buybacks.
kpis.description: Reflects the company's commitment to returning value to shareholders while maintaining balanced capital allocation.

kpis.name: Share Repurchases
kpis.explanation: Amount of shares repurchased by the company under its share repurchase program.
kpis.description: Indicates a reduction in shares outstanding, potentially increasing per-share value.
kpis.signal: $226 million of shares repurchased under the $300 million program.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €3.39 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €0.43 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: New Display Wins
kpis.explanation: Value of new contracts awarded specifically for display products.
kpis.description: Highlights Visteon's strength in the display segment, a key component of the digital cockpit.
kpis.signal: $3.6 billion in new display wins from 17 OEM customers.

kpis.short: New Business in Two-Wheeler and Commercial Vehicles
kpis.name: New Business in Two-Wheeler and Commercial Vehicles
kpis.explanation: Value of new contracts awarded in the two-wheeler and commercial vehicle segments.
kpis.description: Indicates Visteon's expansion beyond its traditional core markets.
kpis.signal: $1.1 billion in new business in two-wheeler and commercial vehicle segments.

kpis.name: SmartCore HPC Program Awards
kpis.explanation: Number of SmartCore HPC (High-Performance Computing) programs awarded.
kpis.description: Highlights Visteon's ability to deliver high-performance computing solutions for advanced automotive cockpits.
kpis.signal: Two SmartCore HPC programs awarded, reinforcing confidence in domain controller architecture.

risks.title: Component Shortages
risks.score_rationale: Shortages of components, particularly electronic chips and DRAM, could have a significant impact on the company's production and sales. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Supply Chain Risks
risks.score_rationale: Supply chain disruptions could have a significant impact on the company's production and sales. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Geopolitical and Tariff Risks
risks.score_rationale: Changes in trade agreements and tariffs could increase production costs and affect industry production volumes. (Item 1A, MDA)

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: Increased competition in the automotive industry could have a significant impact on the company's sales and profit margins.

risks.title: Dependence on a Few Customers
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on a few major customers including Ford, General Motors, BMW, Volkswagen and others. (Item 1A)

ai_positioning.summary: The company VC does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related topics in its 10-K/20-F report.
